description: It is proposed to replace stolen lead to vestry roof hips and abutment flashing to North elevation of Mortuary Chapel, with lead-free alternative.
decision_conditions: <p>The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.</p>

<p>The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.28;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The IKOflash-e product shall be used as a replacement for the lead flashings over the vestry. All disturbed surfaces shall be made good to match the existing form and finish of the listed building.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-7e57bdd5-7fff-05c4-d955-54a5ccb1ab72"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.28;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To preserve the significance of the listed building</span></p>
